Rank 4 Melee Technique

  • Ki Cost: 50 Ki
  • Prerequisites: Piercing Punch
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: Melee
  • Chargeable?: No
  • Duration: Instantaneous (Special)

Strike your foe and either shatter their armor or cut their ki connection to their defenses.

Make a Combo Attack Roll dealing your Unarmed Strike Damage Die on a hit. You also remove one of the following from the target's AC calculation.

  • Armor Bonus
  • Wisdom Modifier
  • Constitution Modifier

This effect lasts for 30 Seconds or until the Armor is repaired.
